description: Pack seven connected Soma pieces into a fixed three-dimensional cradle, using action-triggered inertial motor settles during each seating operation.
name: Polycube Parcel V2 · Difficulty 3 · Full Interaction
natural_language: Fill the fixed 3×3×3 parcel with all seven rigid Soma pieces. Select and rotate pieces, inspect the volume and depth slices, then release the cradle. Use the visible X/Y motor plane, Z depth rail, and the existing seating control. Each deliberate target action runs a deterministic inertial motor settle, while the cradle layout remains fixed when you wait. Stay inside the alignment halo on all three axes during the action-triggered seating transition. The first missed seat, collision, lost alignment or rejected certification ends the episode. Certify only when all 27 cells are filled. Use only screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage.
